BUNDLE.doc: the bundle used, when not taken from the file

CLASS.doc: a group assigned by an exact name has a class that does not fit

CONSTRAINT.doc: at_least_one_of, exactly_one_of, at_most_one_of, all_or_none; attribute length or rank
CONSTRAINT.path: the group; for attribute length and rank the object that owns the attribute

DEPRECATED.doc: a deprecated member or value is used

ENUM.doc: a value outside a closed enumeration

ENUM-OPEN.doc: a value outside an open enumeration

INCOMPLETE.doc: partial mode: a finding that may go away once writing is done; the message names the replaced code

LINK.doc: a dangling link, or a link whose object is not assigned to its target member

MISSING.doc: fewer objects than min (one finding per member and parent)

NAME.doc: a name outside the name rules

NO-CLASS.doc: a group (not the root) has no class

NO-DEFINITION.doc: no group is dispatched (not reported with expect); E with expect: fewer groups follow the expected definition than it requires

REF.doc: a role or names_child attribute names no child, or a child of the wrong kind

SHAPE.doc: rank, dimension or symbol; W for a scalar against length 1, and for symbol conflicts in an entry marked stopped (Q10)
SHAPE.path: the object; the entry (or /) for symbols

SKIPPED.doc: a check not done (read error, unknown feature, tier F)

TOO-MANY.doc: more objects than max; max 0 means forbidden

TYPE.doc: storage type not accepted, or a value check failed (NX_POSINT, NX_BOOLEAN, NX_DATE_TIME; tier S); a definition that is not one text value

UNDECLARED.doc: an object no member declares; E with undeclared: error

UNITS.doc: units attribute absent, not understood, or of a dimension outside the category

UNKNOWN-CLASS.doc: a class not in the bundle; its content is undeclared

UNKNOWN-DEFINITION.doc: a definition that is not an application definition of the bundle

UNKNOWN-RELEASE.doc: a release the validator does not have

decisions.Q1: Occurrence defaults and precedence (minOccurs, optional, recommended)
decisions.Q10: A standard way to mark an entry as aborted or incomplete
decisions.Q11: Ids: a dataset member and a group member may share an id
decisions.Q12: The rules of NXdata and NXobject written in the manual become roles and names_child (T13): DATA named by @signal, AXISNAME by @axes, @auxiliary_signals names datasets, @default names a group; AXISNAME_indices and the other rules of the manual are not checked
decisions.Q13: Reserved prefixes and suffixes (not checked: NXDS states no rule for them)
decisions.Q14: A free-named member of a specialisation applies to every object it matches (a free-named NXdata member of an entry specialisation applies to every NXdata group of that entry)
decisions.Q2: Attributes and links are required by default in an application definition
decisions.Q3: Placeholder characters; may a placeholder be empty; template priority
decisions.Q4: Refinement: override or extend; subclasses where a superclass is expected; name-fit
decisions.Q5: Are shapes binding; scope of a symbol
decisions.Q8: Links: by storage or by content; is a copy acceptable
decisions.Q9: Dispatch: entry points, definition, NXsubentry, root-level members

links.hard: an object with several paths whose target attribute names one of them: every other path is a link to it; without such an attribute all paths are ordinary objects (Q8)

statuses.dormant: in a dormant or stagnant subdirectory
statuses.local: in a class directory given in addition to the repository; not released

ISO8601.doc:
ISO8601 date/time stamp.
It is recommended to add an explicit time zone,
otherwise the local time zone *is assumed* per ISO8601.
The norm is that if there is no time zone, it is assumed
local time, however, when a file moves from one country to
another it is undefined. If the local time zone is written,
the ambiguity is gone.

NX_BINARY.doc: any representation of binary data - if text, line terminator is [CR][LF]

NX_CCOMPLEX.doc:
Compound type cartesian representation of complex numbers (real and
imaginary parts) in NeXus.

NX_CHAR.doc:
A string of characters. The preferred string encoding is :index:`UTF-8`. 
This is the default field type.

NX_CHAR_OR_NUMBER.doc: Any valid character string or NeXus number representation

NX_COMPLEX.doc:
Compound type representation of complex numbers (either
cartesian or polar form) in NeXus.

NX_DATE_TIME.doc:
Alias for the ``ISO8601`` date/time stamp.
It is recommended to add an explicit time zone,
otherwise the local time zone is assumed per ISO8601.

NX_FLOAT.doc: any representation of a floating point number

NX_INT.doc: any representation of an integer number

NX_PCOMPLEX.doc:
Compound type polar representation of complex numbers 
(amplitude and phase *in radians*) in NeXus.

NX_POSINT.doc: any representation of a positive integer number (greater than zero)

NX_QUATERNION.doc:
Compound type representation of quaternion numbers 
(real,i,j,k) in NeXus.

NX_UINT.doc: any representation of an unsigned integer number (includes zero)

NX_ANY.doc: units for things like logs that aren't picky on units

NX_COUNT.doc:
units of quantity of item(s) such as number of photons,
neutrons, pulses, or other counting events

NX_DIMENSIONLESS.doc:
units for fields where the units cancel out
(NOTE: not the same as NX_UNITLESS)

NX_EMITTANCE.doc:
units of emittance (``length * angle``) of a
radiation source

NX_PERIOD.doc:
units of time, period of pulsed source
(alias to `NX_TIME`)

NX_PULSES.doc:
DEPRECATED: see NX_COUNT

units of clock pulses (alias to `NX_NUMBER`)

NX_TIME_OF_FLIGHT.doc:
units of (neutron) time of flight
(alias to `NX_TIME`)

NX_TRANSFORMATION.doc:
units of the specified transformation

could be any of these: ``NX_LENGTH``, ``NX_ANGLE``, or ``NX_UNITLESS``

There will be one or more transformations defined by one or more fields
for each transformation.  The units type ``NX_TRANSFORMATION`` designates the
particular axis generating a transformation (e.g. a rotation axis or a translation
axis or a general axis).   ``NX_TRANSFORMATION`` designates the
units will be appropriate to the type of transformation,
indicated in the :ref:`NXtransformations` base class
by the ``transformation_type`` value:

* ``NX_LENGTH`` for ``translation``
* ``NX_ANGLE`` for ``rotation`` 
* ``NX_UNITLESS`` for axes for which no transformation type is specified.

NX_UNITLESS.doc:
for fields that don't have a unit (e.g. hkl) so that they don't
inherit the wrong units (NOTE: not the same as NX_DIMENSIONLESS)
